verses.cheikh-ahmed-tidiane-sy-ilayka-bisirril-: ʾilayka bisirri l-kāʾināti tawassulī wasirri ṣadā l-qurʾāni yawma t-tanazzuli
daʿāka bihi fī wiḥshati qablu ʾādamu wafī ʾithrihi nūḥu likhawfi t-tazalzuli
wabaʿdahumā khayru l-khalīli wamithluhu kalīmuka fī lafẓi ʾilayka muʿassali
wayaʿqūbu min faqdi l-ḥabībayni yūsufi waʿaynayhi fī ṣabri ladayka mujammali
waʿīsā wafī minwāli ʿīsā muḥammadu faqul lī naʿam rabba l-warā wataqabbali
